invariant: CucaDiagram.applySingleStrategy inventories immediate standalone leaves for each group, but creates and applies a Magma only when that group has at least three standalone leaves. SquareMaker's links therefore never constrain a one- or two-leaf group. For three or more leaves, SquareMaker uses ceil(sqrt(n)) rows, noDisplay(1) within a row, and noDisplay(2) at each new row head.
causal_divergence: The class-standalone-leaf-magma-ordering and deployment-floating-note-svek-lifecycle accounts incorrectly attributed a two-leaf constraint to Java. Their implementations consequently call the SquareMaker port for two members. A fresh left-to-right note-plus-node deployment input exposes the error because the extra invisible edge fixes a rank that Java leaves unconstrained. The class implementation contains the same boundary error even though its original two-notes-plus-class counterexample correctly enters Magma at three leaves.
planned_change: Restore the shared minimum to three standalone leaves in both class and deployment SquareMaker adapters without changing their leaf inventories, source ordering, owner partitioning, branch calculation, or constraints for groups of three or more. Add direct tests that two-member groups receive no Magma constraints while three-member groups retain Java row behavior.
